'''Boltskipper''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Wobbler]] at 6 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Sometimes Boltskipper's head gets all itchy. A quick zap ought to scratch that. Or not. Maybe one more zap will do..."

Boltskipper is an early game, purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Boltskipper is a portmanteaus of "bolt" and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mudskipper mudskipper]. However, the two large, electric blue lightning bolts protruding from its large orange mouth more closely resemble the barbels of a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catfish catfish]. Its underbelly is white, and it has four fins it uses to "walk" and a lighter blue tail fin. 

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "After being told it doesn't have a third evolution, it skipped away with a sullen expression."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26, its bio description said: "Releases stronger electric currents but appears to be in a worse mood. Maybe living closer to a mudflat would help."

==Strategy==
[[File:Boltskipper Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Boltskipper's attack range]]
Great Lightning DPS, can rival [[Voltfawn]] in power. Using Boltskipper with a well paired [[Zappur]] and [[Zapooch]] frontline can almost guarantee a winning lane when going against water [[Zobos]].
